data.headline: Director of Engineering (AI Strategy & Enablement | ex-Google)
data.about: • 21 years in software engineering, 11 in leadership at Google, Intuit, GoDaddy, and Xperi.• Engineering leadership in AI, platforms, and fintech — leading AI enablement at RapidAI.• Scaled YouTube infrastructure to 1.7B daily users and payment platforms to 50K+ terminals.• Proven cross-functional leader, aligning engineering strategy with business objectives.• Certificates in Machine Learning (Stanford) and Data Science (University of Michigan).
data.addressWithCountry: San Francisco Bay Area United States

description.text:
• Own RapidAI's company-wide AI strategy and enablement, building the AI tooling, infrastructure, and standards that let every engineering team adopt AI effectively and efficiently

• Built an AI-powered data intelligence platform that gives business leaders a precise, narrative view of the
business for faster decisions — hands-on with RAG, LLM orchestration, and AI agents (Node/Express, React, Prisma, Snowflake, ClickHouse)

• Led development of AI ToolKit, a company-wide library of 40+ developer-focused AI skills spanning every stage of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, coding, debugging, testing, and customer-issue triage — with built-in connectivity to core engineering systems including AWS, GitHub, Jenkins, Apple Xcode, Jira and Confluence, Jama, Okta, Amplitude, and Asana

• Built tooling to measure engineering productivity gains before and after AI adoption

• Set company-wide best practices and standards for AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Google Gemini), authoring the AGENTS.md single source of truth that governs how AI assistants operate across the codebase to keep AI-generated code consistent, reviewable, and maintainable

• Building coding agents and an AI-powered internal development platform to advance the organization from AI-assisted coding toward higher-leverage agentic workflows

• Owned engineering for the Rapid app (iOS, Android, web) — RapidAI's clinician-facing app delivering AI imaging analysis to physicians and stroke/trauma teams across 2,500+ hospitals in 100+ countries

• Quadrupled engineering productivity by restructuring the team — reducing headcount by 50% while doubling output through process optimization and focused execution

• Compressed release cycles by 66%, moving from a quarterly to a monthly delivery cadence, accelerating time-to-market and tightening customer feedback loops

• Reduced operating expenditure by 50% by strategically relocating engineering teams from a high-cost to a lower-cost geography while preserving delivery quality and velocity

• Elevated talent density by recruiting senior engineers from leading technology companies including Google and Amazon, raising the engineering bar and reinforcing a culture of technical excellence

• Surfaced AI-analyzed CT/MR results to clinicians within ~90 seconds of a scan, speeding triage and treatment for time-critical conditions like ischemic stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, and pulmonary embolism

• Improved app performance 5x on key operations (login, patient browsing, navigation) through a major refactor, while driving multi-year gains in crash rate and stability

• Built secure, HIPAA- and GDPR-compliant care coordination — real-time case alerts, in-app messaging, one-tap calling, and EMR-linked case summaries — replacing fragmented phone-and-pager workflows

• Stood up the engineering operating model from the ground up — defining team structure, hiring standards, and delivery cadence to scale the organization

• Owner of the GoDaddy Payments smart payment terminal software teams, responsible for the development of
payment SDKs (Java, Kotlin), Android OS and apps (Java, Kotlin), and credit card reader firmware (C, C++)

• Delivered high-performance payment software solutions supporting 50K+ terminals globally

• Drove launch of new payment terminal resulting in 30K units shipment in first year

• Delivered best-in-class terminals by aligning banking partners and internal/external teams

• Secured critical L1, L2, L3 payment and security certifications from key partners enabling market expansion•

• Led engineering teams for a top 10 financial app, Credit Karma, acquired by Intuit for US$7 billion

• Managed engineering managers and full-stack engineers using Objective-C, Java, Kotlin, and TypeScript, on
iOS, Android and Web platforms

• Increased revenue by prioritizing and launching key new features with the product team

• Improved core metric Transactions per Daily Active User (TpDAU) through data-driven product optimization

• Managed and led YouTube Infrastructure Engineering team impacting 1.7 billion daily users

• Drove infrastructure projects enhancing scalability, reliability, efficiency, performance for a top 3 global website

• Massively reduced infrastructure costs by driving migration from monolith to micro-services architecture

• Massively enhanced performance and scalability by driving 2-year transition from Python to C++ backend

• Accelerated developer velocity by building Python tools used by 4,000+ engineers

• Led development of Fixture Framework for unified data seeding used across functional, integration and E2E testing

• Owned Sherlog, a widely used YouTube debugging tool, and other test frameworks
Authored comprehensive YouTube Testing Manual handbook guiding over 2,000 engineers

• Mobile owner driving 10x market growth of DTS Headphone:X across iOS, Android, Windows

• Delivered immersive audio to tens of millions by integrating into Qualcomm, Huawei, Asus, Tencent, and KKBOX

• Reduced engineering cost by 20% by building global engineering teams

• Enabled 10x revenue growth through accelerated time-to-market and continuous delivery

• Reduced release overhead 90% via CI/CD automation of packaging and distribution

• Increased code quality 80% through automated testing and static analysis in CI

• Coached and mentored team members through best practices and hands-on collaboration

• Key developer of DTS Headphone:X v1.0 launched with Huawei, providing onsite support in Shanghai

• Drove mobile strategy and execution for a core audio technology across devices and apps globally

• Led mobile team expansion while decreasing time-to-market for new capabilities

• Significantly reduced critical app crashes by instituting stability monitoring and analytics across mobile products

• Accelerated junior engineer proficiency through hands-on mentoring and coaching in best practices

• Mentored engineers through weekly one-on-ones, lifting team expertise and reducing knowledge silos

• Earned Scrum Master certification and led Agile practice adoption improving team velocity and workflow

• Led core development of DTS Headphone:X v1.0 launched globally in partnership with Huawei, delivering hands-on technical guidance in Shanghai.

• Deep Android development skills encompassing SDK, UI, build tools, native interfaces, data persistence, cloud, and concurrency.

• Led development of innovative Android-based set-top box offering transformative smart TV experience

• Engineered Java platform enabling proprietary UI, DRM for protected media, and resilience via error handling

• Pioneered development of first Android in-flight entertainment system, capturing 85% market share

• Created Java SDK for airlines to build engaging custom infotainment applications

• Developed testing application for Boeing to validate infotainment functionality during aircraft assembly

• Developed embedded video playback systems leveraging Android, C++, Qt, Python, and leading compression technologies including MPEG-2, MPEG-4, H.264, and JPEG2000

• Experienced in boot loaders (u-boot), OS kernel, file systems, and cross-compiling tool chains
• Designed and developed solutions utilizing key multimedia formats including MPEG, AVI, TIFF, JPEG, bitmaps

Credential ID: 3LKRLKH3PSFM
Credential URL: https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/specialization/certificate/3LKRLKH3PSFM

The 5 courses in this University of Michigan specialization introduce learners to data science through the python programming language. This skills-based specialization is intended for learners who have a basic python or programming background, and want to apply statistical, machine learning, information visualization, and text analysis techniques to gain new insight into their data. In the final course, students will work on real-world data analysis projects, building a portfolio which showcases their work while at the same time helping real clients gain a better understanding of their data.
